integrity: The theorem is supported by convergent Hilbert–Schmidt error estimates and an analytic half-line convolution resolvent; no finite experiment is asserted to prove an infinite-dimensional fact.
scientific_limitations: Essential norm 2 is relative to the exact coefficient-space weights, not the original analytic Bergman integral norms; Fredholm spectrum is for the specified diagonal endomorphism, not an unnormalized map between spaces. The full norm and ordinary spectrum are not computed.
title: Hilbert–Schmidt Copson model and Fredholm circle at the logarithmic Hilbert-matrix endpoint
